facts.value: Spanish knowledge is strongly recommended for some courses offered in English, but no mandatory language test is required.

TOEFL score of 87 is required for Fudan University, Tongji University, Jiao Tong University (Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance), Jiao Tong University (Antai College of Economics and Management), Nankai University, Xiamen University, Tel Aviv University, Hebrew University, Keio University, University of Kyushu, Nagoya University of Commerce & Business.

IELTS score of 6.5 (no items below 6.0) is required for Fudan University, Tongji University, Jiao Tong University (Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance), Jiao Tong University (Antai College of Economics and Management), Nankai University, Xiamen University, Tel Aviv University, Hebrew University, Keio University, University of Kyushu, Nagoya University of Commerce & Business.

English B2 proficiency is required for Fudan University, Jiao Tong University (Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance), Jiao Tong University (Antai College of Economics and Management), Nankai University, Xiamen University, Tel Aviv University, Hebrew University, Keio University, University of Kyushu, Nagoya University of Commerce & Business.
TOEFL score of 90 is required for University of Tokyo (iBT Home Edition, IELTS Indicator, and IELTS Online are accepted) and Osaka University.
GMAT score of 555 (old version GMAT 600) or equivalent GRE for QTEM Programme.
